row.body: A bank hiring form is attached to a field-use roster; the teller’s start date is written before the training room was cleared.
row.title: The teller position

sidecar.gloss: A teller start date precedes the room clearance.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency office could train staff before reopening; the roster does not identify the field use.

row.body: the tire pump and first-aid kit were wiped on one face and left dusty on the other. field twine and warning tape cross at the handle.
row.title: two traces on the tire pump

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
